items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Prince Robertson's career, band membership (McKinney's), and musical style relative to Coleman Hawkins, but does not describe a direct personal interaction or collaboration between himself and Prince.

ctx.x: Well, Prince, he sounded fine, but he was rusty, you know. He hadn't played the clarinet, you know, so there were squeaks, but what he played was very nice.
Oh, he was -- yes, he was.
